title: REDI-NET B2: Blood Processing Protocol
author: REDI-NET Consortium
materials: Use a pipet to remove the supernatant.
Select the program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Flex_4wash on the instrument.
Select the program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Duo_4wash on the instrument.

steps.title: Process Whole Blood or Buffy Coat Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare blood samples for nucleic acid purification using bead tubes.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of ATL-DX buffer to the bead tubes.
Add 200 µL sterile 1x PBS to a 200 µL whole blood or buffy coat sample (if volume is < 200 µL, add sterile 1x PBS to reach 200 µL).

Prepare positive control: transfer 37.5 µL ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard Material, 100 µL EBV, and 100 µL DENV-1 standard into a bead tube; add 100 µL ATL-DX buffer and 162.5 µL sterile 1x PBS.
Prepare negative control: add 100 µL ATL-DX buffer and 400 µL sterile 1x PBS to a bead tube.
Load samples into the Bullet Blender (refill dry ice if necessary).
Set speed to 12 and time to 3, then press Start.
Let samples settle for 00:01:00 in the Bullet Blender, then repeat the beating step (speed 12, time 3).
Centrifuge tubes with lysate at 12000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C (Stopping point: samples can be stored at 4 °C overnight).

steps.title: Process Cell-Free Fluid Samples
steps.instruction: Concentrate fluid samples and prepare for lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add up to 1.5 mL fluid sample (minimum 0.5 mL) to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge for 00:05:00 at maximum speed (12000-14000 x g).
Add 500 µL ATL-DX buffer and resuspend the pellet by vortexing.
Transfer the entire pellet resuspension to the bead tubes.
Prepare positive control: transfer 37.5 µL ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard Material, 100 µL EBV, and 100 µL DENV-1 standard into a bead tube; add 250 µL ATL-DX buffer.
Prepare negative control: add 500 µL ATL-DX buffer to a bead tube.
Load samples into the Bullet Blender (refill dry ice if necessary).
Set speed to 12 and time to 3, then press Start.
Let samples settle for 00:01:00 in the Bullet Blender, then repeat the beating step (speed 12, time 3).
Centrifuge tubes with lysate at 12000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C (Stopping point: samples can be stored at 4 °C overnight).

steps.title: Process FTA Card Dried Blood Spots
steps.instruction: Extract samples from FTA cards and perform enzymatic lysis.

substeps.instruction: Punch FTA card with a 3.0 mm single-hole puncher.
Use forceps to place three card punches of the same sample into a bead tube.
Add 20 µL Proteinase K, 200 µL QIAcard FTA Wash Buffer, and 200 µL ATL-DX buffer; vortex immediately for 00:00:15.

Prepare positive control: transfer 37.5 µL ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard Material, 100 µL EBV, and 100 µL DENV-1 standard into a bead tube; add 125 µL QIAcard FTA Wash Buffer, 125 µL ATL-DX buffer, and 20 µL proteinase K.
Prepare negative control: add 200 µL QIAcard FTA Wash Buffer, 200 µL ATL-DX buffer, and 20 µL proteinase K to a bead tube.
Incubate in a thermomixer at 1400 rpm, 56 °C, for 1 hour.
Load samples into the Bullet Blender (refill dry ice if necessary).
Set speed to 12 and time to 3, then press Start.
Let samples settle for 1 minute in the Bullet Blender, then repeat the beating step (speed 12, time 3).
Centrifuge tubes with lysate at 12000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C (Stopping point: samples can be stored at 4 °C overnight).

steps.title: Automated Nucleic Acid Extraction (KingFisher)
steps.instruction: Perform TNA extraction using either KingFisher Flex or KingFisher Duo Prime.

substeps.instruction: Select instrument: KingFisher Flex (Program: IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Flex_4wash) or KingFisher Duo Prime (Program: IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Duo_4wash).
Set up plates/strips with Nuclease-free water (75 µL) for elution, 100% ethanol (750 µL), 80% ethanol (750 µL), Buffer AW2 (700 µL), and Buffer AW1 (700 µL).
Add 20 µL Proteinase K to deep-well plate wells (Skip for FTA card samples).
Transfer supernatant to the sample plate: 270 µL for blood/fluid samples or 290 µL for FTA card samples.

Prepare and add master mix (135 µL Buffer VXL, 540 µL Buffer ACB, and 20 µL MagAttract Suspension G per sample; 10% overage recommended). Mix by inverting slowly or using a Hula mixer for 00:02:00. Total volume per well must be 985 µL.
Start the run and load plates/strips when prompted. (For Duo Prime, keep the door open to prevent ethanol vapor contamination).
Upon completion (~ 00:35:00), immediately remove the elution plate and cover or transfer eluate to storage tubes.

steps.title: Quantify Total Nucleic Acids (TNA)
steps.instruction: Measure DNA and RNA concentrations using Qubit 4 Fluorometer.

substeps.instruction: For DNA: Mix 1 µL (blood/buffy coat) or 3 µL (FTA/fluid) of sample with 1xHS dsDNA Qubit Assay to a final volume of 200 µL. Vortex 5-10 seconds, incubate 00:02:00 at room temperature, and read.
For RNA: Prepare working solution (199 µL Qubit RNA HS Assay buffer and 1 µL Dye per sample). Mix 197 µL working solution with 3 µL sample. Incubate 00:02:00 at room temperature and read.
If TNA concentration is too high: dilute 2 µL sample in 18 µL nuclease-free water; use 3 µL of this dilution for quantification.

steps.title: Sample Storage and Testing
steps.instruction: Store or proceed to testing based on required duration.

substeps.instruction: Proceed to testing following REDI-NET SOP B-4 Blood Testing.
Short-term storage: store at -20 °C for less than 2 weeks.
Long-term storage: store at -80 °C following REDI-NET SOP B-3 Blood Storage.
